finding.text: Ask 1 says a new session has a URL and both presses "land on the same new session page", but pressing the button only clears the stored id: no session is created and the URL stays the same (`ux/Dictate/doc/chat.md` +243 says so outright). The proof only checks that the session id goes to none, so the routed new-session page was never built. Either create the session on the press and route to its page, or record why that was skipped and put it on the card as an open item.

Ask 2 wants shots of every mic surface with the mic open at 400 and 1200. `shots/` holds only `sheet-400`, `collapsed-400`, `drawer-1200` and `closed-menu-1200`: the floating mic (`push-to-talk.js`) is not shot at either width, and the sheet and drawer each have one width only. Also, `proof.mjs:15` sets the state by hand with `MicIndicator.set_open(true)`, so no shot shows a real mic driving it.

`ext/drawer/rail.js:376-381`: `DrawerRailSheet` and `DrawerRailSheetPanel` have no `this.mount`, so their New session button now does nothing (the code comment admits this). Both are still registered and demoed (`DrawerRail.SheetPanel`, `SheetLinksV1`, and `ext/drawer/rail/page.js:62` describes the Panel as "today's default" with New session). Fix the button there or the page's text.

With `tabs/ai.js` `new_session()` deleted, a card thread's New session no longer recycles the card's Servex assistant (`/api/agent/<id>/recycle`). The live `DrawerRailSheetChat` never used that path, so nothing visible breaks, but chat.md should say the behaviour was dropped.

The floating mic and the ☰ get only the dot-only `compact` variant, not the level bar the owner described ("has a little level meter"). That is defensible on a small button, but chat.md calls the indicator "one class on every surface", which overstates it.
`MicIndicator.css:6,9` hard-codes `#e5484d` twice instead of using a colour token, which breaks the colour rules and will not follow the theme.

`MicIndicator.js:40`: an instance that is built but never connected stays in `static views` forever, because removal needs `seen`. This is a small leak, and the same applies to a view whose `sync` never runs again after it is removed.

The fence is crossed: `ext/drawer/menu.js`, `push-to-talk.js`, `Widget.js` and `rail.css` are outside it. In `menu.js:30`, `{ capture: false }` is an option `MicIndicator` never reads. Each edit is small and serves ask 2, but the card should name them.
`surfaces.md` item 3 still lists the removed copies' line numbers ("near line 383… near 641") as if they exist. Trim it to "now one: `chat.js`'s `new_session_button`".

Ask 3 (merge, landing line, card with shots) is not shown in the diff or `task.jsonl`, which ends at the assign line. The merge has not happened yet either: the main tree still has the old `new_session` code.

Ask 2's "small listening dot in the sidebar tab when the surface is collapsed" does not show at 400: in `shots/collapsed-400.png` the ✦ button in the bottom rail has no dot, and the only red dot is the floating mic's (that shot is pixel-identical to `shots/floating-400.png`). The compact `MicIndicator` is added in `ext/drawer/rail.js:124`, but it is either not mounted or clipped there. Find out why, then re-shoot with the ✦ dot visible. At 1200 the ☰ dot does work (`shots/closed-menu-1200.png`, top right).

Ask 1 asked that a new session have a URL and that both presses "land on the same new session page". The press only clears the stored session id and the URL stays the same. `ux/Dictate/doc/chat.md` (new section, last paragraph) now records this choice and the alternative, which is fine under "decide and keep going". Because it differs from the brief, also put it on the card as a `Note:` so the owner sees it.

In the proof, the open state is set by hand (`proof.mjs:15`, `MicIndicator.set_open(true)`). So `shots/drawer-1200.png` shows "listening" in the indicator while the composer status below it says "Mic: idle". Only `shots/sheet-400.png` shows a real mic ("Mic: on, level ok") driving the indicator. The sheet is shot only at 400 and the drawer only at 1200. They are the same surface at two widths, so that coverage is acceptable.

In `shots/sheet-400.png` and `shots/drawer-1200.png`, the floating mic (forced on by `proof.mjs:14`) sits on top of the right end of the indicator's level bar. That overlap only happens in the proof setup, but if both can be open at once in real use, the bar needs room at the right.
`ext/drawer/menu.js:30` passes `{ capture: false }`, which `MicIndicator` never reads. Either drop it or confirm it is a `View` option.

Ask 3 is not done yet: no merge and no landing line (`task.jsonl` ends at the assign line and the first review). The first review's other points are fixed in 9e69311b5: the colour token (`--error`), the never-mounted leak, the old sheet classes now resetting the shared session through `chat.reset`, and the trimmed `surfaces.md` line.
